title: Skill drawer — chips on the right

steps.headline: Are the chips in the right place now?
steps.changed: Each status chip sits at the right edge of its skill card. The red Unavailable chip no longer has a separate 'Set up in Projects' caption beside it. Its green, amber, and red backgrounds and dots now use the same color definitions as the session switcher.
steps.notice: Click the red chip or the rest of its muted card to open the saved project's setup rows. Hover brightens the chip and card; keyboard focus remains visible. The missing skill still cannot run.
steps.risk: These are still workbench sample statuses, not project policy. I verified that clicking the red chip itself reaches Projects; no live settings changed.
